name: Youth Justice Services
shortDescription: Programs and support for young people in contact with the youth justice system, including case management, specialist support and community-based supervision.
plainEnglishSummary: If you are a young person involved with the youth justice system, this service may help you understand available support, make positive choices and reconnect with family, community and culture.
audience: Children and young people in contact with the youth justice system
Young people under youth justice supervision
Families and carers seeking information about youth justice support
availabilityNote: Access to particular programs depends on the young person's circumstances and involvement with the youth justice system.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm access or eligibility. Contact Youth Justice Services or the relevant supervising team to discuss which support may be appropriate.
